clue.text: Bird with vegetable seed

parts.note: a chick is a young bird
a pea is a common green vegetable

explanation.surface: A bird is pictured alongside a vegetable seed, perhaps pecking at it.
explanation.definitionFit: The chickpea is the edible round seed of a leguminous plant, used in hummus.

clue.text: Bad luck, Robin has a pair of spectacles

parts.note: Robin Hood, the outlaw of English legend
two round lenses look like the letters O and O

explanation.surface: Someone suffers misfortune because a bird called Robin is wearing glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: Robin is not the bird but the legendary outlaw Robin Hood; spectacles are pictured as two circles, OO.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoodoo is a jinx, a source of misfortune.

clue.text: It is most important for cook to include one

indicators.note: the cook's word takes the numeral for one into its middle

parts.note: a chef is a professional cook
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cook is told that including one particular ingredient matters above all.
explanation.definitionFit: Chief as an adjective means principal, foremost in rank or significance.

clue.text: Petty formality Colin and I put differently

indicators.note: saying something in another way suggests rearranging the letters of the words around it

explanation.surface: Colin and the speaker phrase a trivial rule of etiquette in their own words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put differently' is the anagram signal, but 'put' also supplies three letters of the fodder: COLIN, I and PUT rearranged; 'and' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A punctilio is a fine point of etiquette or a minute detail of conduct.

clue.text: Sailor employing bad language

definitions.note: a noun phrase standing for the verbal noun: the act of reviling someone

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
employing means using

explanation.surface: A sailor is caught swearing, as sailors are reputed to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Abusing someone is insulting them with offensive words, i.e. swearing at them.

clue.text: Girl before morning accepts a greeting

indicators.note: the girl's name comes ahead of the rest in the answer

parts.note: Sal is a short form of the girl's name Sally

indicators.note: the morning abbreviation takes the letter a inside it

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means morning

explanation.surface: A girl, ahead of the morning, takes on a greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A salaam is a ceremonial bow of salutation in Muslim and Indian cultures.

clue.text: Pair sat round having fish

indicators.note: the word sat goes around the abbreviation for pair

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Two people sat in a circle eating a fish supper.
explanation.definitionFit: The sprat is a small silvery food fish of the herring family.

clue.text: Languor of girl, one performing duet!.

parts.note: a lass is a girl
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: a performance of the word duet is taken as acting on its letters, putting them through their paces

explanation.surface: A girl, worn out after singing a duet, is overcome by weariness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' turns DUET into TUDE, which follows LASS and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassitude is physical or mental weariness, a lack of energy.

clue.text: Book the second half of July every year

parts.note: an annual is a book published once a year, e.g. a children's annual

indicators.note: keep the back two of the four letters of July

explanation.surface: A book is to be published in late July each year.
explanation.definitionFit: Annually means once a year, yearly.

clue.text: Not still to be voted on

explanation.surface: A proposal that refuses to stay put is put to a vote.
explanation.definitionFit: Motion is movement, the opposite of being stationary; it is also a formal proposal put to a meeting for a vote.

clue.text: Going to London getting up a revolt

parts.note: travelling up to London is the British idiom: one goes up to the capital
rising means getting up out of bed

explanation.surface: Someone heading to London rises in rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage you go UP to London (and to university) from anywhere else.
explanation.definitionFit: An uprising is a rebellion, a popular revolt against authority.

clue.text: Such money, being virtually worthless, might be flung

definitions.text: Such money, being virtually worthless, might be flung

parts.words: Such money, being virtually worthless, might be flung
parts.note: paper currency so devalued it is fit only to be tossed like scraps of paper over a newly married couple

explanation.surface: Banknotes so inflated they are worthless might as well be thrown away.
explanation.definitionFit: Confetti money is a slang term for hugely inflated paper currency, and confetti is tossed at weddings.

clue.text: Warfare between different classes of people?

definitions.text: Warfare between different classes of people?

parts.words: Warfare between different classes of people?
parts.note: fighting between groups of people suggests class war, but the groups are clans, as in the phrase for feuding among ethnic groups

explanation.surface: A question about class warfare.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribal warfare is conflict between tribes, which are distinct groups of people.

clue.text: Such a nice way to give complete pleasure

parts.note: delight is great pleasure, here as a verb: to please
fully means completely

explanation.surface: A gentle way of giving someone total pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Delightfully means in a charming, pleasing manner, so a nice way of doing something.

clue.text: Raids once uncovered a prehistoric monster

indicators.note: excavated letters are dug up and laid out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Raids on a dig once unearthed the remains of a prehistoric beast.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests fossil hunting; 'uncovered' is the anagram signal on RAIDS ONCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dinoceras is an extinct horned mammal of the Eocene, a huge rhinoceros-like beast.

clue.text: Brave tribal symbol

parts.note: brave is a Native American warrior, and the symbol is the carved emblem of his people

explanation.surface: A courageous emblem of a tribe.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem pole is a carved and painted post bearing a tribe's emblems in Pacific Northwest cultures.

clue.text: Come together to have drinks in the company establishment

indicators.note: the drinks are placed within the company and establishment pair

parts.note: CE, the Church of England, is the Established Church
ales are beers

explanation.surface: Colleagues meet up for drinks at the firm's premises.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'establishment' here is the Church of England, the established church, abbreviated CE.
explanation.definitionFit: To coalesce is to merge or unite into one whole.

clue.text: Become engaged!

parts.note: the exclamation suggests a wedding proposal, but engaging means joining combat with an enemy

explanation.surface: A cry of congratulation for a couple getting engaged.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops engage the enemy when they begin fighting them.

clue.text: Tree arrives with second person from France in the vehicle

parts.note: AR is the timetable abbreviation for arrives

indicators.note: the French pronoun sits inside the vehicle

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle
tu is the French familiar word for you, the second person singular

explanation.surface: A tree arrives with a French visitor riding a bus.
explanation.definitionFit: Arbutus is the strawberry tree, an evergreen shrub or small tree.

clue.text: One in French = one in English almost-complete agreement

parts.note: un is French for one
the equals sign is read as is

indicators.note: the English word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: the English word for one

explanation.surface: An equation of French and English numbers suggests near total accord.
explanation.walkthrough: The sign '=' is read as 'is'; ONE loses its last letter to give ON.
explanation.definitionFit: In unison means in perfect accord, everyone acting or speaking together.

clue.text: Put in the first three

explanation.surface: Simply something put in the top three.
explanation.definitionFit: Placed is the past tense of put or set; in racing a horse that is placed finishes second or third, among the top finishers.

clue.text: Imagine mother going round again

indicators.note: the mother word encircles the word for again

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
re- means again, as a prefix

explanation.surface: Someone pictures their mother doing another lap.
explanation.definitionFit: To dream is to fancy or picture something in the mind.

clue.text: Be studying in silence it's stupefying

parts.note: musing is pondering, contemplating quietly

explanation.surface: Quiet study leaves one bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: Bemusing means bewildering or puzzling, leaving one dazed.

clue.text: Savoury juice I had

parts.note: sap is the juice of a plant
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a tasty juice they once drank.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapid means having a pleasant, strong flavour, so tasty.

clue.text: Reunites stranger who is rapacious

indicators.note: more strange suggests the letters of reunites set out in an odder way

explanation.surface: A grasping person reunites with someone strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Esurient means greedy or hungry, voraciously grasping.

clue.text: Counter work by model

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
to model is to pose for an artist

explanation.surface: A piece of work sits beside a model on a shop counter.
explanation.definitionFit: To counter an argument is to resist or contest it.

clue.text: Aircraft taking man thrown overboard

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase standing for the noun: goods cast from a ship

parts.note: a jet is an aircraft
Sam is a man's name

explanation.surface: A plane picks up a man who has been tossed off a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Jetsam is cargo deliberately cast from a vessel to lighten it.

clue.text: Making progress beyond the legal limit

explanation.surface: Getting along fast, perhaps faster than the law allows.
explanation.definitionFit: Speeding means moving quickly, advancing; it is also driving faster than the permitted maximum.
